limitations: Stored calibration equality does not establish physical calibration integrity.
Epipolar residuals are scene-dependent selected SIFT/fundamental-RANSAC inliers, not a metrology certification.
Projector controls keep L2 powered; no L2-off control, so no definitive optical interference attribution.
Nearest receipt-time offsets describe host arrivals, not exposure/firing or hardware synchronization.
No post-fall fixed declaration or independent trajectory: pose excursions are descriptive, not static drift/ATE/RPE.
L2 host/device clock slope remains about 2; IMU units and axes are unvalidated, so no LIO.
First RGB-D/ICP temporary wrapper incorrectly treated unavailable child exit codes as failure; both native sessions completed. Later wrapper fixed and stereo/KISS child exits were 0.
